review.reason: A new high-security data centre was taken into customer use, and the page states that Erillisverkot is a wholly state-owned special-task company, so the state operates a data centre today.

findings.note: An operator page, independent of the statute, stating that the state-owned company runs data centres in 15 underground facilities.

review.reason: The wholly state-owned special-task company Erillisverkot owns 15 underground facilities containing data centres, which the page says are intended for public services.

findings.question: indicator K1: Is the root of the government's public key infrastructure or its qualified trust service operated by the state or a state-controlled body?

findings.note: The state agency publishes its own government roots (DVV Gov. Root CA - G3 RSA/ECC). The printed source is the original 2009 act text, which still names the former Väestörekisterikeskus.

review.reason: The root and CA certificates belong to the Digital and Population Data Services Agency (DVV), a state agency, so the government PKI root is operated by the state.

findings.question: indicator K2: Is the national electronic identity scheme operated by the state or a state-controlled body?
findings.quote: Digi- ja väestötietovirastolla on lakisääteinen velvoite tarjota Suomi.fi-tunnistusta. Velvoitteesta on säädetty tukipalvelulaissa.
findings.quote_english: The Digital and Population Data Services Agency has a statutory obligation to provide Suomi.fi identification. The obligation is laid down in the Support Services Act.
findings.title: Suomi.fi-tunnistuksen tietosuojaseloste
findings.note: The state runs the national identification hub. Most strong eID credentials that pass through it (bank codes, mobile ID) are issued privately, so the Yes applies to the hub, not to the credentials.

review.reason: DVV, a state agency, has a statutory duty to provide Suomi.fi identification; note this is the national authentication service, and the quote does not describe the underlying credentials.

findings.title: Laki Suomen säädöskokoelmasta 188/2000 (ajantasainen)
findings.note: Section 1. The version list also shows a 2026 amendment (853/2026) that may not yet be in this consolidation.

review.established: Suomen säädöskokoelma (Statute Book of Finland; operator not stated)
review.reason: The quote establishes the Statute Book as the publication for legislation but does not say who operates it.

findings.question: Emergency calls and public-safety radio: 112/PSAP systems, emergency dispatch and TETRA/public-safety networks

findings.question: Education: Student records, diplomas and qualifications
findings.quote: Perusopetuksen, lukiokoulutuksen ja ammatillisen koulutuksen valtakunnallinen tietovaranto 4 § Tietovarannon käyttötarkoitus
findings.quote_english: National data repository for basic education, general upper secondary education and vocational education. Section 4: Purpose of the data repository
findings.value: Perusopetuksen, lukiokoulutuksen ja ammatillisen koulutuksen valtakunnallinen tietovaranto (national data repository for basic, general upper secondary and vocational education)
findings.title: Laki valtakunnallisista opinto- ja tutkintorekistereistä 884/2017 (ajantasainen)
findings.note: Chapter 2 heading. The Act's title was changed by 1450/2025 from 1 January 2026, and the same Act sets up the learner number register (oppijanumerorekisteri).

review.established: Perusopetuksen, lukiokoulutuksen ja ammatillisen koulutuksen valtakunnallinen tietovaranto (national education data repository; operator not stated)
review.reason: The quote is a chapter and section heading naming the repository, with no operator.
